scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof of the universal sharp bound, explicit equality classes and attainable optimizer. Exact finite arithmetic corroborates rather than certifies every size. Unindexed graph-theoretic coverage remains a literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted binary interaction networks; each secondary taxon has exactly two distinct primary partners; all-partners-lost one-step extinction only; uniform without-replacement or iid common-risk primary loss. The claim does not cover dynamic rescue, dependence, heterogeneous species risks, or higher secondary degrees.
title: Sharp coextinction-variance minimizers in two-partner ecological networks
